    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import io\n",
        "import requests\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import joblib\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler\n",
        "from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import sliding_window_view\n",
        "from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential\n",
        "from tensorflow.keras.layers import Input, LSTM, Dense, Dropout\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"1. Fetching dataset...\")\n",
        "csv_url = \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/finance-charts-apple.csv\"\n",
        "response = requests.get(csv_url)\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(response.text))\n",
        "data = df[[\"AAPL.Close\"]].dropna().values\n",
        "print(\"Loaded trading records:\", len(data))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"2. Preparing tensors...\")\n",
        "scaler = MinMaxScaler(feature_range=(0, 1))\n",
        "scaled_data = scaler.fit_transform(data).flatten()\n",
        "\n",
        "LOOKBACK = 60\n",
        "windows = sliding_window_view(scaled_data, window_shape=LOOKBACK + 1)\n",
        "X = windows[:, :-1]\n",
        "y = windows[:, -1]\n",
        "\n",
        "split_idx = int(len(X) * 0.8)\n",
        "X_train = X[:split_idx]\n",
        "X_test = X[split_idx:]\n",
        "y_train = y[:split_idx]\n",
        "y_test = y[split_idx:]\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train = np.reshape(X_train, (X_train.shape[0], X_train.shape[1], 1))\n",
        "X_test = np.reshape(X_test, (X_test.shape[0], X_test.shape[1], 1))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"3. Building Stacked LSTM...\")\n",
        "model = Sequential()\n",
        "model.add(Input(shape=(X_train.shape[1], 1)))\n",
        "model.add(LSTM(units=50, return_sequences=True))\n",
        "model.add(Dropout(0.2))\n",
        "model.add(LSTM(units=50, return_sequences=False))\n",
        "model.add(Dropout(0.2))\n",
        "model.add(Dense(units=25))\n",
        "model.add(Dense(units=1))\n",
        "\n",
        "model.compile(optimizer=\"adam\", loss=\"mean_squared_error\")\n",
        "model.summary()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"4. Training Model (15 epochs)...\")\n",
        "history = model.fit(X_train, y_train, epochs=15, batch_size=32, validation_data=(X_test, y_test), verbose=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"5. Evaluating & Generating Plot...\")\n",
        "predictions_scaled = model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "predictions = scaler.inverse_transform(predictions_scaled)\n",
        "y_test_actual = scaler.inverse_transform(y_test.reshape(-1, 1))\n",
        "\n",
        "rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test_actual, predictions))\n",
        "mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test_actual, predictions)\n",
        "print(f\"Test RMSE: {rmse:.2f} USD\")\n",
        "print(f\"Test MAE:  {mae:.2f} USD\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))\n",
        "plt.plot(y_test_actual, color=\"black\", label=\"Actual Price\")\n",
        "plt.plot(predictions, color=\"red\", linestyle=\"--\", label=\"Predicted Price\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Stock Price Prediction (Actual vs Predicted)\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Trading Days\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Price ($)\")\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
        "plt.savefig(\"lstm_prediction_plot.png\", bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "joblib.dump(scaler, \"stock_scaler.pkl\")\n",
        "model.save(\"stock_lstm_model.keras\")\n",
        "print(\"Day 3 completed successfully! Model & scaler saved.\")\n"
      ],
